column1: # The rule. Walk chr1 through chr22, chrX and chrY in that order. On each
# contig take every position that is a multiple of 500,000 and does not exceed
# the contig length the shipped executable reports. At each position submit
# four candidate SNVs, one per reference base A, C, G, T, each with the next
# base in the cycle A->C->G->T->A as its alternate. Score the candidates
# through the published SNV dataset alone (`pangopup lookup --bundle`). The
# dataset answers `found` for the candidate whose REF matches the published
# source reference and `not_found` for the other three, so at most one
# candidate per position survives. Every surviving candidate is a line below,
# in contig order and then ascending position.
# The rule reads only the shipped v0.5.0 SNV bundle
# It picks no variant by hand and no gene by name.
# One variant per line. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are not part of
